mission: Owner decision 2026-10-26: a promo code that only appears in promo products (P-017, P-019, P-102, P-103, P-104, P-106 in the standard-battle batch) gets its canonical card by consensus over its occurrences in ESTABLISHED products: coded, already-held uncoded, or uncoded products this run proved and authorised through app.services.uncoded_product_evidence. Same consensus rule as before (identity fields must agree exactly; rarity optional); occurrences under unproven products still count for nothing.

impacts.reason: _coded counts established occurrences (coded, held uncoded, authorised uncoded); authorised names threaded through audit_canonical_baselines and resolve_canonical_baseline.
Promo only in a proven uncoded product gets its canonical card; two proven products disagreeing on the name establish nothing.

impact.deployment_impact: None until an owner-approved catalogue-import apply; then promo-only cards in proven products are created instead of skipped.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: A promo canonical card with wrong identity fields.
recovery.backup: Railway Postgres backup under 24 h, checked before every apply.

verification.observation_window: standard-battle dry run: the 8 skipped promo prints become creates.
